title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms — Episode1 I Want to Get Better

meta.Episode: Episode1 — I Want to Get Better
meta.Event Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for seeing me again, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, um... Thank you too, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, would you like to start with some warm-ups...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Lead the way...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to say it, but this doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... You might want to relax a little more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And it may also help to sing more from your stomach to make sure your throat stays open.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, from my stomach...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, that's it.
You sound much better than before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see, like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Kusanagi.
That helped quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it still feels like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm singing with everything I have. I don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe it's just a matter of confidence, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Confidence...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
The first time I heard you sing, you seemed to sort of have doubts about your own abilities.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And even now, it seems like there's a small part of you somewhere that still feels that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Doubts about my abilities...
You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't worry. I was the same way, so I know how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? You were...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something I did a long time ago during a play I was in made me completely lose confidence in myself...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No matter how many times I tried to sing after that, it felt like there was something missing the same way you feel right now, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So how were you able to overcome that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remembered why it was so fun to sing, and everything felt much better after that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why it was so fun to sing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I'm still not even sure if I've fully returned to being my old self...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that feeling of something being missing has vanished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However, I also don't think it's a good idea to dwell on it too much. That kind of obsession could end up making things worse.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Experiencing that moment when you feel like singing is fun will probably help you the most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay. I understand...
Thanks, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, shall we start from the top?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, please!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi!
Your voice sounds amazing today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Does it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I can even tell through my drumming. I'm not sure how to put it into words, but it felt like we played so well because your voice sounded so light on its feet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. It's all thanks to Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You've been getting advice from her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have, and she's been helping me practice even when it gets pretty late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's great!
Your hard work is really paying off too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
We did sound pretty good just now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(All this praise is so encouraging.
I'm glad I asked Kusanagi for her help.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I want to touch someone's heart with my music, like they did with mine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's why I have to get better...
I want to become a pro and reach more people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that my music can really get them going too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My singing is nowhere near that level yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to get better and really learn how to perform with everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (How do I move up from here...?)
